description: This file implements a custom slog.Handler for the logr logging library, providing integration with slog and handling log levels, attributes, and grouping.

classes.name: slogHandler
classes.description: A custom implementation of slog.Handler that forwards logs to a LogSink or SlogSink, with support for log levels, grouping, and attribute handling.

methods.name: GetLevel
methods.description: Returns the current level bias of the handler, used for testing.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Determines if logging is enabled for a given level.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes a slog.Record, forwarding it to the appropriate sink.

methods.name: sinkWithCallDepth
methods.description: Adjusts call stack unwinding for correct logging call reporting.

methods.name: WithAttrs
methods.description: Returns a new handler with additional attributes.

methods.name: WithGroup
methods.description: Returns a new handler with an added group prefix.

methods.name: attrToKVs
methods.description: Converts slog.Attr to key-value pairs for logging, handling groups.

methods.name: addPrefix
methods.description: Concatenates a prefix and name with a separator.

methods.name: levelFromSlog
methods.description: Converts a slog.Level to an integer level, adjusted by levelBias.
